hypothesis: lambda=1 reduces within-rollout decay compared with .98 during Act1-to-Act2 adaptation; still critic-bootstrapped at rollout boundary.
primary_objective: normal-Neow-start A20 Ironclad Act1+Act2 joint clear
train_seed_replication_limit: one shared seed; replicate only after promising development evidence
scheduling: one 48h GPU-long allocation, same node/runtime: control then experimental, then paired analysis. Each arm retains 24h preparation cap; remaining allocation minus 30min analysis reserve also gates the next arm.
checkpoint_rule: fixed endpoints primary; periodic selected checkpoints diagnostic only
success: experimental fixed endpoint improves >=.01 absolute versus both matched control and frozen90; exact two-sided McNemar/Holm family alpha .05; healthy completion and true joint successes in [2M,3M),[3M,4M+overshoot).
failure: Incomplete or incompatible evaluations are execution problems; uncertain gain is inconclusive; no joint gain prevents automatic extension.
scope: finite simulator pilot, no whole-Act2 certification or real-game win-rate estimate
